description: This file (irr.py) contains functions related to analysis of behavioral observation data in the BORIS (Behavioral Observation Research Interactive Software) project. It includes functions for computing inter-rater reliability, Cohen's kappa, Needleman-Wunsch similarity, and other observation data comparison metrics, primarily interacting with a SQLite database of aggregated behavioral events.

methods.name: list subj_behav_modif(cursor, obsid: str, subject: str, time: dec, interval, include_modifiers: bool)
methods.description: Retrieves behaviors and modifiers for a specific subject at a given time within an observation, from the database.

methods.name: cohen_kappa(cursor, obsid1: str, obsid2: str, interval: dec, selected_subjects: list, include_modifiers: bool)
methods.description: Calculates Cohen's kappa inter-rater reliability coefficient between two observations over a specified time interval, considering selected subjects and modifiers.

methods.name: irr_cohen_kappa(self)
methods.description: High-level function to perform Cohen's kappa analysis across multiple observations, with user interaction to select observations and subjects.

methods.name: needleman_wunsch_identity(cursor, obsid1: str, obsid2: str, interval, selected_subjects: list, include_modifiers: bool)
methods.description: Computes the Needleman-Wunsch similarity score (identity) between two observations based on their behavioral sequences over a time interval.

methods.name: needleman_wunch(self)
methods.description: Extends the Needleman-Wunsch similarity calculation to multiple observations, with user interaction to select observations and behavior categories.
